title: Custom Sample Plating and ELISA Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the fields provided above.

steps.title: Prepare protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol files and unzip them if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your custom labware files with .json extensions, if needed.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload your protocol file that has a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button to start the custom sample plating and ELISA protocol (supports up to 88 samples on up to 3 ELISA plates).
